# Architecture and context instructions

- Read `.ai/project/architecture/structure.md` before broad structural edits.
- Read `.ai/project/stack/current-stack.md` before changing build, runtime, or dependency patterns.
- If structure and code diverge, prefer code and suggest a docs update.
- Document new architectural decisions in `.ai/project/architecture/decisions.md`.
